record.body:
## Evidence

Reviewer confirmed the wheel contains dashboard/backend/server and all nine smoke checks pass.

## Consequence

The R15 requirement text still says dashboard.web.

## Follow-up

None.

payload.basis: The dashboard server moved to dashboard/backend/server in the remove-textual and data-layer phases of the dashboard effort, so dashboard.web no longer exists. The wheel smoke script and tests import dashboard.backend.server; the acceptance test ids are unchanged.
payload.claim: R15 retargeted from dashboard.web to dashboard.backend.server
payload.invalidated_when: A human wants the spec text changed to the new module path

record.subject: wheel-smoke-r15-retarget
